scope: Proposition 7.6 (Organized pair graph) of the manuscript “A power saving for planar unit distances” (preprints/A-power-saving-for-planar-unit-distances-September-23-2026/paper.pdf), one of the manuscripts of result family 167 of openai/math at commit 1581d4cbdd69. The statement is quoted verbatim from the text that pdftotext 24.02.0 (-raw -enc UTF-8) extracts from the PDF (SHA-256 72bfa9153772b212), with whitespace normalised, and was found there under this heading on PDF page 41. Text extraction flattens typeset mathematics (superscripts, subscripts, fractions, large operators, delimiters), so the quote can read differently from the typeset statement and can carry characters with no Unicode meaning; the PDF is authoritative. Finding the quote shows that the manuscript states it, not that it is true. AMVO has checked nothing about this claim.
statement: For the incidence graphs and levels constructed above, there are J → ∞, a sequence ωt → 0, and a simple bipartite graph E between two copies of P, each of size at most t1+o(1), with at least t2−o(1) edges, having the following properties. Each edge (p, r) has distinct endpoints and an assigned center q = q(p, r) ∈ Q with pq, rq ∈ E. Set λpr = zp − zq(p,r) zr − zq(p,r) . No edge has both endpoints on any real unit circle containing at least t9/10 points of P. Uniformly over the edges and complete rectangles of E, (zp − zr)(wp − wr) = 2 − λpr − λ−1 pr , (7.13) h(λpr) ≥ J/3, (7.14) h λprλp′r′ λpr′ λp′r ! ≤ ωtJ. (7.15) In the last line all four indicated edges are required to be present; their assigned centers need not agree. The edge ratios λpr are unrelated to the fixed score constant λ.
